prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
The Green Party’s 2024 manifesto is a plan for real hope: a fairer, greener UK that tackles the cost of living, restores public services, and confronts the climate and nature emergencies with urgency and justice.

- NHS and care: Keep the NHS fully public, end privatisation and rebuild capacity. Fund GPs, dentists and hospitals to cut waits; invest at least £8bn extra in year one for the NHS in England, rising to £28bn by 2030, plus £20bn capital over five years. Back fair pay and staff retention. Create a National Cancer Plan and guarantee timely mental health care. Deliver free personal care and rebuild the care workforce with £20bn per year.

- Homes: Treat housing as a right. Build 150,000 genuinely affordable social homes a year; end Right to Buy; empower rent controls and end no-fault evictions. Launch a Fairer, Greener Homes Guarantee: invest £29bn to insulate homes to EPC B, £9bn for clean heat, and adapt homes for a warmer climate. Mandate Passivhaus-level standards, solar and heat pumps in new builds.

- Energy and climate: End new oil and gas licences and fossil subsidies; introduce a rising carbon tax; turbocharge renewables (wind to ~70% of power by 2030) and remove barriers to community energy. Stop new nuclear and phase out existing plants. Expand grid, storage and interconnectors. Deliver a just transition with union-led skills, local ownership and secure green jobs.

- Economy and ownership: Invest on average £40bn per year in a Green Economic Transformation—clean power, home retrofit, public transport, water, nature and skills. Bring rail, water and the Big 5 retail energy companies into public ownership to run services for people, not profit. Reform finance to divest from fossil fuels and fund the transition.

- Fair taxation and public finances: Tax wealth and pollution, not work. Introduce a wealth tax (1% above £10m; 2% above £1bn). Align capital gains and investment income with earnings tax; remove NI upper limit; reform inheritance tax. Introduce a carbon tax rising towards £500/tonne within a decade. Borrow to invest, rejecting austerity.

- Nature and animals: Pass a Rights of Nature Act; protect and restore 30% of land and sea by 2030; re-wet peat, expand woodlands and urban nature; bring water into public hands; ban destructive fishing in MPAs; end factory farming and blood sports.

- Food and farming: Nearly triple farm support to drive nature-friendly, mixed farming and horticulture, cut pesticides and river pollution, and boost local food. Free school meals for all children and food education in schools.

- Education: Invest in schools and SEND; end high-stakes testing and Ofsted; restore grants and scrap tuition fees; fund lifelong learning.

- Transport: Make public transport affordable and reliable with major bus and rail investment; bring rail into public ownership; build safe walking and cycling networks; phase out new petrol/diesel car sales by 2027 and road use by 2035; oppose new road building.

- Democracy and rights: Replace first-past-the-post with proportional representation; votes at 16; repeal voter ID; curb big money in politics; defend human rights, LGBTIQA+ rights and protest.

- Migration and justice: End the hostile environment; create safe asylum routes; allow work while claims are decided. Shift from punishment to prevention and rehabilitation; expand restorative justice; decriminalise personal drug possession.

- Global: Support Ukraine; demand an immediate Gaza-Israel ceasefire, end UK arms sales to Israel, recognise Palestine, and uphold international law. Rejoin the EU when feasible; sign the UN Nuclear Ban Treaty and cancel Trident. Increase aid to 1% GNI and climate finance to 1.5% by 2033.

Vote Green for real change—fairness, dignity and a safe climate future.
